children.value: > Fact From Story: A class action lawsuit accuses Google of anticompetitive behavior, arguing it siphons off news publishers’ content, readers, and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > Fact From Story: The complaint argues that Google is “starving the free press” by sharing publishers’ content on Google, losing them “billions of dollars.”
> > Fact From Story: The lawsuit specifically cites new AI technologies like Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard AI chatbot as worsening the problem.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Sharing content without permission and proper compensation is harmful to the content creators.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Antitrust laws are designed to prevent anticompetitive behavior.
